missing_minimum_package_for_target: Manufacturer-controlled configuration or delivery data sheet binding order code, hardware drawing revision, firmware revision, guaranteed propellant/performance configuration to baseline or explicit replacement.

Mechanical ICD or controlled GA drawing: module coordinate datum, every nozzle ID/exit xyz/force unit vector and command-index mapping, mounting dimensions/tolerances, connector mating/withdrawal envelope, plume limits, wet/dry CG/inertia.

Electrical ICD: connector exact part and pin numbering/view, power/return/chassis mapping, RS422 TX/RX polarity/ground, supply tolerance and ripple, heater/valve startup+hold waveform and permitted simultaneous loads, power-on/off fault states.

Software ICD/protocol manual matching firmware: link settings, framing, byte order, CRC definition, address/opcode dictionary, arming/inhibit/timeouts/watchdog, minimum pulse/duty and allowed concurrent jet sets, acknowledgements, telemetry format/scaling/faults, protocol test vectors.
